# F05 Criteria

## Create an ActivityTypeSelector Component

- The `components` directory contains the starter code for the `ActivityTypeSelector` component.
  - The `components/ActivityTypeSelector` directory exists. 
  - The `components/ActivityTypeSelector` directory contains `ActivityTypeSelector.vue`
  - The `components/ActivityTypeSelector` directory contains files with Cypress component tests.

## Implement the ActivityTypeSelector Component

- The `ActivityTypeSelector` example page in `modules/farm_fd2_examples/src/entrypoints/activity_type_selector/App.vue` displays a `ActivityTypeSelector` component.
  - `ActivityTypeSelector.vue` is imported at the top of the `<script>` element.
  - `ActivityTypeSelector` is included in the `components` object in the Vue data.
  - The `<template>` section includes a `ActivityTypeSelector` element.
- The `SelectorBase` component in `ActivityTypeSelector.vue` has `id` and `data-cy` attributes defined.
- The props of the `SelectorBase` component in `ActivityTypeSelector.vue` are correctly configured.
  - The `SelectorBase` component's `label` and `invalidFeedbackText` props are assigned static values.
  - The `SelectorBase` component's `required` and `showValidityStyling` props are bound to the incoming props with the same name.
  - The `SelectorBase` component's `options` prop is bound to an array log category names.
- The `ActivityTypeSelector` handles and re-emits the `valid` and `update:selected` events from the `SelectorBase` component.
- The `ActivityTypeSelector` defines a prop that can be used to set the selected item.
  - This prop is bound to the `selected` prop of the `SelectorBase` component.

## Update the ActivityTypeSelector Example Page

- The "Component Event Payloads" contains a row for the `selected` event.
  - The "Payload" column displays the payload of the `selected` event from the `ActivityTypeSelector` component.
- The "Controls" for the `ActivityTypeSelector` work correctly.
  - The value of the `Required` control is bound to the `required` prop of the `ActivityTypeSelector` component.
  - The value of the `ShowValidityStyling` control is bound to the `showValidityStyling` prop of the `ActivityTypeSelector` component.

## Write Tests for the Component

- The `ActivityTypeSelector.content.comp.cy.js` has been updated.
- An `it` checks the initial content of the entrypoint.
  - The `it` checks that the label displays appropriate text.
  - The `it` checks that the required element does not exist.
  - The `it` checks that at least two of the selector options contain log categories.
  - The `it` checks that no styling is applied to the selector.
  - The `it` checks that the invalid feedback test is set and that it is not displayed.
- An `it` checks that the `ActivityTypeSelector` props are are passed to the `SelectorBase` component.
  - The `it` checks that setting the `required` prop to `true` displays the `*` indicating that a value is required.
  - The `it` checks that setting the `showValidityStyling` prop to `true` styles the element appropriately.
- All `cy.get` and `find` statements use `data-cy` attributes to get elements.

## Refactor the Activity Observation Entry Point

- The "Activity Observation" entry point in `modules/farm_fd2/src/entrypoints/activity_observation/App.vue` uses the `ActivityTypeSelector` component.
  - `ActivityTypeSelector.vue` is imported at the top of the `<script>` element.
  - `SelectorBase.vue` is not imported at the top of the `<script>` element.
  - `ActivityTypeSelector` is included in the `components` object in the Vue data.
  - `SelectorBase` is not included in the `components` object in the Vue data.
  - The `<template>` section includes a `ActivityTypeSelector` element.
  - The `<template>` section does not include a `SelectorBase` element.
- The "ActivityTypeSelector" component's `update:selected` event is connected to a property in `form` in the Vue `data`.
- The "ActivityTypeSelector" component's `valid` event is connected to a property in `validity` in the Vue `data`.

## Optional Extensions

- The "Component Props" table in `modules/farm_fd2_examples/src/entrypoints/activity_type_selector/App.vue` contains a row for the `selected` prop.
  - The row contains a control that sets the `selected` prop.
- The JSDoc comments in `components/ActivityTypeSelectorActivityTypeSelector.vue` document the component.
  - The block comment at the top of the `<script>` documents the `ActivityTypeSelector` component.
  - The "Usage Example" gives an example `ActivityTypeSelector` element.
  - The "data-cy Attributes" table gives the `data-cy` attribute value for the `SelectorBase` element.
- The `popupUrl` of the `SelectorBase` element in `components `components/ActivityTypeSelectorActivityTypeSelector.vue` is bound to the url `/admin/structure/taxonomy/manage/log_category/add`.
